{{Quote|Regretfully, our garrison intercepted his team before they could prevent the Killiks from landing on Thyferra."''<br />''"You don't mean to say&mdash;''"<br />''"I'm afraid I do. The Killiks have taken control of our bacta supply.|Gilad Pellaeon and Jacen Solo|<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>}}
The '''coup on Thyferra''' occurred in [[36 ABY]] during the [[Swarm War]], when a group of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and [[Membrosia/Legends|black membrosia]]-addicted [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] took control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], seizing control of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] along with it. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was dispatched with a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to prevent the coup, but they were held up by [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] forces in a misunderstanding, and thus were unable to stop the Killiks from seizing control.
